name: humanifyai
description: Regional English rewriter with a bundled dictionary and no model API key

scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ ! -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; fi; exec .venv/bin/uvicorn app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-10000}'
